name: Versailles 1685
publisher: Cryo Interactive Entertainment / Canal+ Multimedia / Réunion des Musées Nationaux

locations.note: Lalande, a young valet de chambre, has until nightfall on the summer solstice of 1685 to search the palace and grounds for clues and keys after a pamphlet threatens to burn the castle, and he defuses a bomb in the attic passageway.
